fields.description: The workbook (BOQs) this match run belongs to.
fields.label: BoQ

fields.description: The committed sheet name, VERBATIM (#152 -- never stripped).
fields.label: Sheet Name

fields.description: The committed sheet's commit_version the Suggest run it followed was made at. A carry (selected rows, resume) reads only a previous match run at the SAME version.
fields.label: Committed Version

fields.description: The BoQ Rate Suggestion Run this match run followed (SEQUENCE ruling: matching starts only after a Suggest run finishes COMPLETE, and reads that run's rows and readings).
fields.label: Suggest Run

fields.description: The match job's id (raw 32-char hash from the enqueue): what the healer checks the live queues for.
fields.label: Job Id

fields.description: queued (created by the trigger) | running | complete (every target row matched or named) | failed (an error; the reason is in Halt Reason) | halted (the healer found its worker gone, or a stop of the call runner). A failure never touches the Suggest run.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Whether this is the live match run for the sheet (as the Suggest run's flag): a COMPLETE run sets the prior active run for (boq, sheet_name) to 0 (retained, never deleted). get_match_results reads the active run only.
fields.label: Active

fields.description: How many target rows this pass matches.
fields.label: Rows Total

fields.description: How many of them are done (their judge call answered, or nothing to judge).
fields.label: Rows Done

fields.description: Why the run failed or halted, in plain language.
fields.label: Halt Reason

fields.description: When the run ended. Set by the worker.
fields.label: Run At

fields.description: {"rows": [{excel_row, target_key, matches IN DISPLAY ORDER (green, then amber, then red; the judge's own order within a colour; DIFFERENT never shown), each {key, boq, sheet_name, excel_row, verdict, colour, n1b, supply_rate, install_rate, total_rate, unit, priced_at}, judge_order (the judge's raw order: key + verdict before N1b), no_verdict, carried}]}. JSON.
fields.label: Results

fields.description: Spend and time, recorded never capped (owner 2026-11-02 23:23): cards and judge apart (calls, tokens in / out, USD), seconds per phase, the lane workers, the pool's as_of, the pass's scope and what was carried.
fields.label: Usage
